𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗩𝗜𝗖𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗔𝗡 𝗣𝗢𝗞𝗘𝗥 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗠𝗣𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦𝗛𝗜𝗣 𝗥𝗘𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗡𝗦 𝗜𝗡 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲!

After delivering a massive $2 Million Series in 2025, the Victorian Poker Championship is set to return to the iconic Crown Poker Room from 12-27 October 2026.

Fresh off the hugely successful return of the Aussie Millions, Crown Melbourne is once again preparing to welcome players from across Australia and around the world for two weeks of championship poker action.

With major events, packed side schedules, industry-leading tournament operations, and one of the most prestigious poker rooms in the Asia-Pacific, all signs point to the Victorian Poker Championship aiming to go even bigger in 2026.

12-27 October 2026

Crown Melbourne Poker Room

The countdown starts now!
